title: DEPHYRIER Kua Whakauru (Installed Not Finished)
style: install-not-ship pulse 98 bpm trilingual EN MI FR DEPHYRIER signature integration-stacked work-not-shipped warm-pad spoken-maori ledger-tone
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Notion connected HeyGen installed all on the same day
March seven the integrations stacked the chain in array
App installed is a card not a feature shipped
The install is the start the work has not slipped

[Pre-Chorus — Te Reo Māori]
Kua honoa kua whakauruhia kia tika
(Connected installed correctly)
Engari kāore anō kia oti te mahi
(But the work is not yet finished)

[Chorus — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER installed is not finished yet
Kua whakauru kei te mahi tonu
(Installed still working)
Installé ne veut pas dire terminé
(Installed does not mean finished)

[Verse 2]
Three apps in one day connected to the workspace
A stack on paper is not a stack with a face
Wiring the integrations is the second act
Not the headline the steady fact

[Bridge — French]
L'installation est le début pas la fin
(The installation is the start not the end)
Le travail véritable suit le chemin
(The real work follows the path)

[Outro — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER installed not finished
Kua whakauru kei te mahi tonu
DEPHYRIER installé pas terminé
